mapei/planitop-raso-max.source: CONSUMPTION: Approximately 1.45 kg/m2 per mm of thickness. Application thickness: 2-10 mm.
mapei/planitop-raso-max.caveat: The 2 to 10 mm bounds are the sheet's own, printed both as the application thickness and on the bag. The 3 mm default is the calculator's, because the sheet names no recommended thickness within that range: set it to the job. The sheet also prints the mix as 100 kg of powder to 22-24 kg of water, which is the 5.5-6.0 litres it tells you to put in the bucket before a 25 kg bag, and a fresh mix density of 1700 kg/m3.

mapei/pulicol-2000.source: COVERAGE: Coverage depends on the amount and type of adhesive: as a general rule, coverage is 0.3 kg/m2.

tiers.label: General rule, one application
tiers.hint: The only rate the sheet prints

mapei/pulicol-2000.caveat: The sheet prints one rate and says coverage depends on the amount and type of adhesive being removed, so 0.3 kg/m2 is a general rule and not a guarantee. It also says that in certain circumstances a second application may be necessary, which is the second application on the control above and doubles the quantity.
